# NEOioic selected snapshot

Runtime core, xmake entries, architecture/tutorial/style documents, hello-world and diamond-inheritance examples, and focused runtime regressions. See NEOCC_SOURCE.json for the pinned revision and file hashes, and LICENSE for MIT terms.

No WGI, historical manuals, old binaries or repository metadata is included. Upstream document links may refer to omitted material. The runtime and selected regressions have now been built and run with MinGW-w64 GCC in Debug/Release, and with NeoCC for the documented native combination. See ../../docs/testing.md for actual coverage. Runtime sources remain pinned and unchanged.
